1966.long_comment: The Sixers will be resting several players for this contest, and James is one of the many projected starters who will be taking a seat alongside Joel Embiid and Jaylen Brown. The 76ers will manage James' workload carefully with an eye toward having him ready for the regular-season opener against the Knicks on Tuesday, Oct. 20.
1966.name: LeBron James
1966.short_comment: James (rest) won't be available for Saturday's preseason contest against the Celtics, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.

2490149.long_comment: McCollum and most of Atlanta's regulars won't play in the penultimate preseason game. He recorded 12 points (2-4 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 7-7 FT) and five rebounds across 19 minutes in Saturday's 119-117 preseason win over the Pacers.
2490149.name: CJ McCollum
2490149.short_comment: McCollum (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

2530530.long_comment: McConnell has not been practicing and has not played this preseason, but the Pacers have not disclosed exactly what he's dealing with. His next chance to suit up will come Tuesday in Oklahoma City.
2530530.name: T.J. McConnell
2530530.short_comment: McConnell (undisclosed) did not play during Saturday's 119-117 preseason loss to the Hawks.

2581018.long_comment: LeBron James (rest), Joel Embiid (rest) and Jaylen Brown (rest) will join Caldwell-Pope on the inactive list for Saturday's exhibition, which may result in major minutes for Rayan Rupert and Caleb Love. Caldwell-Pope's next chance to play will come Friday in a rematch with the Celtics.
2581018.name: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
2581018.short_comment: Caldwell-Pope (rest) won't play in Saturday's exhibition against the Celtics, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.

2991230.long_comment: VanVleet made his first appearance since suffering an ACL injury more than a year ago, finishing with 17 points (5-12 FG, 5-12 3Pt, 2-3 FT), seven assists, two rebounds and two steals in 24 minutes during Friday's 135-117 preseason win over Dallas. The veteran point guard will likely be limited throughout the 2026-27 season, but he's on track to be the starting point guard on Opening Night.
2991230.name: Fred VanVleet
2991230.short_comment: VanVleet (rest) isn't expected to play in Sunday's preseason game against the Mavericks, Will Guillory of The Athletic reports.

2991235.long_comment: Adams totaled two points (1-1 FG), three rebounds, one assist and one steal in 14 minutes during Friday's 135-117 preseason win over the Mavericks, marking his first game action since undergoing ankle surgery in January. The veteran center is expected to be the primary backup to Alperen Sengun this season.
2991235.name: Steven Adams
2991235.short_comment: Adams (rest) isn't expected to play in Sunday's preseason game against the Mavericks, Will Guillory of The Athletic reports.

2991350.long_comment: Caruso and the rest of the Thunder's regulars won't travel to Atlanta but are expected to suit up Tuesday, when they host Indiana. The veteran wing has averaged fewer than 20 minutes per game in each of his first two seasons in Oklahoma City, but his positive real-life impact has been undeniable.
2991350.name: Alex Caruso
2991350.short_comment: Caruso (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Hawks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

3032977.long_comment: Antetokounmpo is one of several projected starters who won't be available for this preseason matchup. This is likely a rest-related move in order to have Antetokounmpo available for the regular-season opener on Oct. 21 against the Timberwolves, especially since he was limited to just 36 regular-season games with the Bucks in the 2025-26 regular season. His next chance to play will come against Brooklyn on Wednesday.
3032977.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
3032977.short_comment: Antetokounmpo (rest) won't be available for Saturday's preseason game against the Timberwolves, Eric Nehm of The Athletic reports.

3059318.long_comment: Head coach Nick Nurse is resting most of the vets for Saturday's exhibition, so Jabari Walker could get all the run he can handle. Embiid should return for Friday's preseason rematch with Boston.
3059318.name: Joel Embiid
3059318.short_comment: Embiid (rest) is out for Saturday's exhibition against the Celtics, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.

3059319.long_comment: Wiggins will skip Saturday's exhibition for maintenance reasons, but he should return for Wednesday's preseason game against Brooklyn. Wiggins' absence should open up minutes for Myron Gardner and Simone Fontecchio.
3059319.name: Andrew Wiggins
3059319.short_comment: Wiggins (rest) won't play in Saturday's preseason game against the Timberwolves, Eric Nehm of The Athletic reports.

3062679.long_comment: Per Stefan Bondy of The New York Post, Hart will sit out Tuesday's exhibition for rest, as it is the second night of a back-to-back set during the preseason. Hart's absence should open up minutes for Landry Shamet and Jordan Clarkson.
3062679.name: Josh Hart
3062679.short_comment: Hart recorded two points (1-2 FG, 0-1 3Pt), three rebounds, three assists and one steal over 22 minutes in Monday's 122-104 preseason loss to the Timberwolves.

3102530.long_comment: Nurkic will begin the 2026-27 season on the sidelines, and given the tricky nature of foot injuries for big men, it wouldn't be shocking to see his absence extend beyond this initial four-week window. Jaren Jackson will likely spend more time at center while Nurkic is out, and there will be more minutes available for Jaxson Hayes and Mo Bamba.
3102530.name: Jusuf Nurkic
3102530.short_comment: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

3102531.long_comment: Porzingis has yet to report to Warriors training camp while dealing with an undisclosed issue. He's running out of time to make a preseason appearance, and it sounds like the big man is in real jeopardy of missing the start of the regular season at this point.
3102531.name: Kristaps Porzingis
3102531.short_comment: Porzingis (undisclosed) remains away from the team, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.

3133626.long_comment: Williams and the rest of the Thunder's regulars won't travel to Atlanta but are expected to suit up Tuesday, when they host the Pacers. Williams has averaged 15.5 minutes per game over the past three seasons in Oklahoma City, starting 10 of his 194 regular-season appearances.
3133626.name: Kenrich Williams
3133626.short_comment: Williams (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Hawks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

3135045.long_comment: Allen performed well in the Hornets' opening preseason game, posting 13 points in 14 minutes, but he will miss Sunday's contest with a knee injury. Sion James and Royce O'Neale could see extra action with Allen out of the lineup.
3135045.name: Grayson Allen
3135045.short_comment: Allen will not play in Sunday's preseason game against the Bucks due to right knee soreness.

3136193.long_comment: Booker won't be an option for Saturday's game due to rest, as the Suns are managing his workload carefully with the start of the regular season right around the corner. Booker's next chance to play will come in the rematch against San Antonio on Wednesday.
3136193.name: Devin Booker
3136193.short_comment: Booker is not playing in Saturday's preseason game against the Spurs due to rest, Hayden Cilley of ClutchPoints.com reports.

3136195.long_comment: Towns was solid, if unspectacular, as New York fell to 0-3 in preseason play. The standout center has played in each of the first three contests but will take a seat for the second half of the back-to-back set Tuesday at Toronto. Towns' next chance to suit up will come Thursday at home against the Raptors.
3136195.name: Karl-Anthony Towns
3136195.short_comment: Towns ended with 11 points (3-6 FG, 1-4 3Pt, 4-4 FT), four assists, two rebounds and one steal over 22 minutes in Monday's 122-104 preseason loss to Minnesota. He won't play Tuesday against Toronto for rest purposes, Stefan Bondy of The New York Post reports.

3147657.long_comment: According to Stefan Bondy of The New York Post, Mike Brown said that he will hold out his regular starters for Tuesday's game in Toronto for rest purposes. With Bridges and the rest of the first unit unavailable, Jordan Clarkson might see a large uptick in usage.
3147657.name: Mikal Bridges
3147657.short_comment: Bridges finished with nine points (3-6 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 2-2 FT), two rebounds and two assists over 22 minutes in Monday's 122-104 preseason loss to the Timberwolves.

3155942.long_comment: Sabonis has missed two straight games for undisclosed reasons, but it sounds like it's a minor issue. If the veteran big man doesn't suit up Tuesday, his final chance to play during the preseason will come Friday in San Antonio.
3155942.name: Domantas Sabonis
3155942.short_comment: Saboins (undisclosed) was a full participant during Monday's practice but remains questionable for Tuesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

3202.long_comment: According to coach Ime Udoka, Durant was initially scheduled to play only the first half Friday but requested additional minutes to build chemistry with Fred VanVleet and his other new teammates. The veteran forward's absence Sunday appears to be a planned precaution rather than an injury-related setback, and Houston should have additional minutes available for its other wings and forwards
3202.name: Kevin Durant
3202.short_comment: Durant will not play in Sunday's preseason rematch against Dallas, Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports. The forward finished Friday's preseason contest with 15 points (7-12 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 0-1 FT), two assists and one block in 23 minutes.

3213.long_comment: The veteran center isn't making the trip to Las Vegas for this exhibition. He'll look to return for Friday's preseason finale versus Portland.
3213.name: Al Horford
3213.short_comment: Horford (rest) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Lakers, per Nick Friedell of The Athletic.

3904625.long_comment: This is a tough blow for Fall, as he's already facing an uphill battle to make the final roster. A return Oct. 16 isn't out of the question based on this timetable.
3904625.name: Tacko Fall
3904625.short_comment: Fall was diagnosed with a left hip strain Thursday and will miss at least two weeks, Kyle Neubeck of AllPHLY.com reports.

3907497.long_comment: Murray is dealing with a right toe contusion, though head coach Jamahl Mosley said his absence Thursday is precautionary. The veteran point guard's next chance to play in the preseason will come Wednesday against Dallas.
3907497.name: Dejounte Murray
3907497.short_comment: Murray (toe) has been ruled out for Thursday's preseason game against the Heat, Andrew Lopez of Gulf Coast Sports & Entertainment Network reports.

3913176.long_comment: The Clippers learned about the injury this summer, though it's unclear exactly how far along Ingram is in his recovery. The star forward's timeline for a return is unclear, clouding his fantasy outlook in the meantime. Darius Garland should take on all the usage he can handle in Ingram's stead, while Kris Dunn and Max Strus could have additional streaming appeal early in the year.
3913176.name: Brandon Ingram
3913176.short_comment: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

3917376.long_comment: Brown will skip his first meeting against his former team in Boston, but he should be able to get back out there for Friday's rematch with the Celtics. Justin Edwards and Dean Wade will help pick up the slack Saturday with Brown unavailable.
3917376.name: Jaylen Brown
3917376.short_comment: Brown (rest) won't suit up for Saturday's preseason game in Boston, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.

3934672.long_comment: It's the second night of a back-to-back set in the preseason, so the Knicks will sit out their entire starting unit. Expect more minutes for Miles McBride and Tyler Kolek.
3934672.name: Jalen Brunson
3934672.short_comment: Brunson (rest) won't suit up for Tuesday's preseason game in Toronto, Stefan Bondy of The New York Post reports.

3934673.long_comment: DiVincenzo is approaching six months since tearing his right Achilles during the first round of the playoffs and has been rehabbing with the expectation that he'll play at some point this season. The veteran guard has sought advice from Jayson Tatum, Tyrese Haliburton and Damian Lillard during his recovery, though Minnesota has yet to establish a timetable for his return.
3934673.name: Donte DiVincenzo
3934673.short_comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

3934719.long_comment: Anunoby put forth a solid scoring effort, fueled by perfection at the charity stripe, while also tallying a team-high three steals in the loss. The veteran wing has scored in double figures in each of his three preseason appearances, but he'll be inactive for the second half of the back-to-back set Tuesday at Toronto. Anunoby's next chance to suit up will come Thursday, also against the Raptors.
3934719.name: OG Anunoby
3934719.short_comment: Anunoby totaled 15 points (4-8 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 6-6 FT), three steals, two rebounds and one assist over 22 minutes in Monday's 122-104 preseason loss to Minnesota. He won't play Tuesday against Toronto for rest purposes, Stefan Bondy of The New York Post reports.

3950760.long_comment: Kelley inked a deal with the Heat on Thursday, but he has yet to suit up for Miami during the preseason. His next chance to play will come Wednesday against the Nets.
3950760.name: Kylor Kelley
3950760.short_comment: Kelley (calf) did not play during Saturday's 125-124 preseason loss to the Timberwolves.

4065654.long_comment: Isaac has been dealing with a left knee injury throughout camp, but he will miss a second straight preseason game due to personal reasons. His next chance to suit up comes Wednesday against the Cavaliers.
4065654.name: Jonathan Isaac
4065654.short_comment: Isaac (personal, knee) is out for Sunday's preseason game against the Cavaliers, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

4065778.long_comment: Plantar fascia injuries can be tricky to recover from, with the only remedy typically being prolonged rest, so don't be surprised if Strus' absence extends well beyond this initial four-week window. With Strus now set to miss at least the first few weeks of the season, and Bradley Beal (knee) uncertain for opening night, Keaton Wagler could be thrust into the first unit sooner than expected.
4065778.name: Max Strus
4065778.short_comment: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

4066211.long_comment: The Trail Blazers are giving the veteran big man a maintenance day Monday. Williams' next chance to play comes Tuesday against Sacramento.
4066211.name: Robert Williams III
4066211.short_comment: Williams (rest) is out for Monday's preseason game against London.

4066218.long_comment: Williams will be re-evaluated the first week of the regular season, putting his status for Opening Night in the air. Williams will have a difficult path to minutes this season as he competes with the likes of Naz Reid, Royce O'Neale and Tidjane Salaun.
4066218.name: Grant Williams
4066218.short_comment: Williams will miss the preseason after suffering a right hamstring injury, the Hornets announced Friday.

4066259.long_comment: Fox was listed in the starting lineup for Thursday's game but was a late scratch and will miss a third straight exhibition Monday. The extent of his injury remains unclear, but the Spurs have made no indication that the veteran point guard is in danger of missing Opening Night. For what it's worth, the Spurs are resting most of their regulars, including their expected starting lineup for Monday's game.
4066259.name: De'Aaron Fox
4066259.short_comment: Fox (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Monday's preseason game against the Jazz, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.

4066261.long_comment: Adebayo is one of several projected starters who won't be available for the Heat in this preseason contest due to rest. The star big man could return to face Brooklyn on Wednesday, as the Heat are taking a cautious approach to have him fully available for the regular-season opener against the Timberwolves on Oct. 21.
4066261.name: Bam Adebayo
4066261.short_comment: Adebayo won't be available for Saturday's preseason game against the Timberwolves due to rest, Eric Nehm of The Athletic reports.

4066262.long_comment: Monk should make his preseason debut at some point in the near future. He'll try to do Tuesday versus Portland.
4066262.name: Malik Monk
4066262.short_comment: Monk (rest) participated in Monday's practice, per James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento.

4066320.long_comment: Bane will sit out Orlando's second exhibition game for rest purposes. The 28-year-old swingman's next opportunity to suit up in the preseason will come in Tuesday's rematch against the Cavaliers.
4066320.name: Desmond Bane
4066320.short_comment: Bane (rest) has been ruled out for Sunday's preseason game versus Cleveland, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

4066383.long_comment: While Bridges won't play Saturday, he was able to practice Friday, so he's trending in the right direction. His next chance to suit up will come Wednesday in a preseason rematch with the Spurs.
4066383.name: Miles Bridges
4066383.short_comment: Bridges (ankle) won't play in Saturday's preseason game against the Spurs, Hayden Cilley of ClutchPoints.com reports.

4066650.long_comment: Collins continues to deal with a toe injury that has kept him out of preseason action. The veteran big man will look to return before the regular season begins, though his availability for Chicago's next exhibition remains uncertain.
4066650.name: Zach Collins
4066650.short_comment: Collins (toe) did not play in Sunday's 133-128 preseason loss to Denver.

4066993.long_comment: This is a tough blow for the point guard who was penciled in as the top backup behind Davion Mitchell. If he indeed misses a couple weeks, he could be back in time for their final preseason contest Oct. 16.
4066993.name: Dru Smith
4066993.short_comment: Smith will miss a couple weeks with a strained right calf, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

4222252.long_comment: Hartenstein and the rest of Oklahoma City's regulars won't travel to Atlanta for the first half of a back-to-back set. The veteran center has yet to suit up during the preseason due to an ankle injury, and his status for Tuesday's home game against Indiana remains unclear.
4222252.name: Isaiah Hartenstein
4222252.short_comment: Hartenstein (ankle) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Hawks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

4277811.long_comment: Sexton has missed multiple preseason games due to what was initially described as a lower-body injury, but Redick was more specific about the nature of Sexton's health concern Saturday. With two more exhibition games left on the schedule, the Lakers may keep Sexton sidelined until the team's regular-season opener against the Warriors on Wednesday, Oct. 21.
4277811.name: Collin Sexton
4277811.short_comment: Lakers head coach JJ Redick said Saturday that Sexton is day-to-day due to a lower-leg injury, Jovan Buha of The Athletic reports.

4277880.long_comment: Williams is remaining on the inactive list for the Spurs on Monday. Wednesday's matchup with the Suns marks his next chance to play.
4277880.name: Malik Williams
4277880.short_comment: Williams (undisclosed) is out for Monday's preseason game against Utah, per Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News.

4277951.long_comment: Garza took an inadvertent elbow to the nose from teammate Chris Cenac, and the former was taken to the locker room shortly thereafter. Assuming Garza doesn't return, he'll end his night with eight points (4-9 FG), seven rebounds and one assist over 11 minutes.
4277951.name: Luka Garza
4277951.short_comment: Garza (nose) went to the locker room late in the fourth quarter of Saturday's preseason game against the 76ers, Bobby Manning of CLNS Media Network reports.

4278053.long_comment: The Heat will be resting their entire starting lineup for Saturday's preseason game, so expect ample minutes for guys like Ryan Conwell and Bez Mbeng. Mitchell should return for Wednesday's exhibition against the Nets.
4278053.name: Davion Mitchell
4278053.short_comment: Mitchell (rest) won't suit up for Saturday's exhibition against the Timberwolves, Eric Nehm of The Athletic reports.

4278067.long_comment: This is a huge blow for Claxton and it rules him out for the entire preseason. For now, fantasy managers can consider him questionable for Opening Night on Oct. 21 against the Raptors. Jalen Smith is the next man up on the depth chart for Chicago, followed by Zach Collins (toe).
4278067.name: Nic Claxton
4278067.short_comment: Claxton tweaked his hamstring and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Chuck Swirsky of the Bulls Radio Network of the Bulls Radio Network reports.

4278073.long_comment: Gilgeous-Alexander and the rest of the Thunder's regulars won't travel to Atlanta for Monday's game, but they are expected to suit up during the second half of their back-to-back set Tuesday, when they host Indiana. Gilgeous-Alexander produced 17 points (5-5 FG, 3-3 3Pt, 4-4 FT), three rebounds, five assists and a block across 18 minutes in Wednesday's 128-126 preseason loss to the Bucks.
4278073.name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
4278073.short_comment: Gilgeous-Alexander (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against Atlanta, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

4351851.long_comment: Simons continues to deal with tightness in his hamstring, though he's trending in the right direction. For now, he's questionable at best for the next preseason game Oct. 16 against the Celtics.
4351851.name: Anfernee Simons
4351851.short_comment: Simons (hamstring) was limited at Monday's practice, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

4395630.long_comment: Vassell is joining the rest of San Antonio's usual starters on the sidelines Monday. His next chance to suit up arrives Wednesday against Phoenix.
4395630.name: Devin Vassell
4395630.short_comment: Vassell (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against Utah, per Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News.

4395651.long_comment: White missed time with a left calf strain last season and is now in jeopardy of starting the regular season on the inactive list. If the 26-year-old guard is forced to miss time beyond the preseason, Christian Anderson and Dennis Schroder would likely see increased playing time.
4395651.name: Coby White
4395651.short_comment: The Hornets announced Monday that White suffered a left calf strain during training camp and will not play during the preseason.

4396818.long_comment: It's a tough break for Miller, who had an opportunity to battle for a reserve role during training camp in the fall. The timeline for a return is likely to keep him on the shelf until after the All-Star break. Miller's extended stay on the sidelines gives Kobe Sanders a chance to crack the Clippers' rotation.
4396818.name: Jordan Miller
4396818.short_comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

4396963.long_comment: Hinson is managing a left adductor injury that'll keep him sidelined Monday. The forward appeared in Utah's first two preseason games, and his next chance to suit up will come Friday against Phoenix.
4396963.name: Blake Hinson
4396963.short_comment: Hinson (adductor) has been ruled out for Monday's preseason game against San Antonio.

4396993.long_comment: Haliburton missed a preseason contest due to an ankle issue, but his full participation in Monday's practice suggests he's making progress toward returning to game action. However, Carlisle indicated that the guard's availability for Tuesday's preseason matchup against Oklahoma City won't be determined until game day. His status remains worth monitoring, though the unrestricted practice session is an encouraging sign.
4396993.name: Tyrese Haliburton
4396993.short_comment: Haliburton (ankle) participated in Monday's practice without restrictions, head coach Rick Carlisle told Tony East of Forbes.com.

4397020.long_comment: Dort is sitting out Monday for maintenance purposes. The veteran swingman's next chance to play is Friday against Dallas.
4397020.name: Luguentz Dort
4397020.short_comment: Dort (rest) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

4397183.long_comment: Wiggins and most of Atlanta's regulars won't play in the penultimate preseason game. He finished with 13 points (4-9 FG, 3-6 3Pt, 2-2 FT), two rebounds, an assist and two steals across 20 minutes off the bench in Saturday's 119-117 preseason win over the Pacers.
4397183.name: Aaron Wiggins
4397183.short_comment: Wiggins (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

4397251.long_comment: Harper is working through right shoulder illness, which has prevented him from playing in each of the Celtics' first two preseason games. His next opportunity to play is Wednesday against the Hornets.
4397251.name: Ron Harper Jr.
4397251.short_comment: Harper (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's preseason game against the 76ers, Jack Simone of BostonSportsJournal.com reports.

4431680.long_comment: Okongwu is getting the night off Monday with Atlanta resting a number of starters. His next chance to play arrives Friday against Dallas.
4431680.name: Onyeka Okongwu
4431680.short_comment: Okongwu (rest) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

4431684.long_comment: Jackson-Davis is working his way back from a dental procedure. His status remains up in the air for Tuesday's preseason game against the Knicks.
4431684.name: Trayce Jackson-Davis
4431684.short_comment: Jackson-Davis (dental) practiced Monday, per Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet.

4431786.long_comment: Johnson doesn't sound to be a candidate for preseason reps, but it's encouraging to hear he's progressing in his hamstring recovery. A two-way player, Johnson will likely be shuttled to the G League's Sioux Falls Skyforce once healthy later this fall.
4431786.name: Keshad Johnson
4431786.short_comment: Johnson (hamstring) is practicing in a limited fashion, per Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel.

4432107.long_comment: Sasser will miss a second straight exhibition game due to left adductor soreness. It's unclear when he'll be cleared to play again, but Sasser has three more chances to suit up during the preseason, with his next chance coming Wednesday against the Pelicans.
4432107.name: Marcus Sasser
4432107.short_comment: Sasser (adductor) won't play in Sunday's preseason game against the Rockets, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.

4432165.long_comment: Suggs has been dealing with an illness lately, and although he has made progress in his recovery, he is not yet ready to play. His next chance to suit up comes Tuesday against the Cavaliers.
4432165.name: Jalen Suggs
4432165.short_comment: Suggs is out for Sunday's preseason game against the Cavaliers, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

4432166.long_comment: Cunningham wasn't announced in the starting lineup for this contest, with Daniss Jenkins taking his place, but the star guard didn't even step on the hardwood. This was likely a precautionary move to manage Cunningham's workload before the start of the regular season, so fantasy managers shouldn't worry too much about his absence. His next chance to play in the preseason will come Wednesday against the Timberwolves.
4432166.name: Cade Cunningham
4432166.short_comment: Cunningham (rest) didn't play in Saturday's 114-108 preseason loss to the Wizards.

4432171.long_comment: Moody suffered the injury March 23 and underwent season-ending surgery four days later. The 24-year-old had been targeting September to resume running and on-court work, so his latest progress appears to keep his rehabilitation on track, though he remains without a firm timetable for his return to game action.
4432171.name: Moses Moody
4432171.short_comment: Moody has progressed to light on-court activities as he continues his recovery from a ruptured left patellar tendon, Evan Webeck of The Mercury News reports.

4432185.long_comment: Peavy missed a third consecutive contest due to an ankle injury. His final chance to play in the preseason will come next Friday against Charlotte.
4432185.name: Micah Peavy
4432185.short_comment: Peavy (ankle) did not see the floor in Friday's 104-100 preseason win over the Bulls.

4432586.long_comment: Bittle has been working through a foot injury since at least early September. The Raptors have four preseason games left, but it's unclear whether Bittle will suit up for any of those games or whether he'll be available for the team's regular-season opener against the Bulls on Wednesday, Oct. 21.
4432586.name: Nate Bittle
4432586.short_comment: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Saturday's exhibition game against the Clippers, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

4432810.long_comment: Stewart, who was traded from Detroit to Memphis over the summer, sustained a left ankle sprain in the team's preseason opener and is now likely to miss Opening Night. His absence opens the door for Quinten Post to move into the backup center role behind Zach Edey in the interim.
4432810.name: Isaiah Stewart
4432810.short_comment: The Grizzlies announced Friday that Stewart (ankle) will miss at least two weeks.

4432823.long_comment: Williams and the rest of the Thunder's regulars won't travel to Atlanta for the first half of a back-to-back set. The veteran backup has yet to play during the preseason due to a heel injury, and his status for Tuesday's home game against the Pacer remains unclear.
4432823.name: Jaylin Williams
4432823.short_comment: Williams (heel) won't play in Monday's preseason game against Atlanta, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

4432847.long_comment: Shannon will be unavailable at Madison Square Garden after starting Saturday against the Heat. Across three preseason games, the wing is averaging 11.3 points, 3.3 assists and 2.7 rebounds in 18.5 minutes per contest.
4432847.name: Terrence Shannon Jr.
4432847.short_comment: Shannon (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Monday's preseason game against the Knicks.

4433136.long_comment: Kessler has yet to suit up in the preseason after jamming his finger during training camp, though the injury isn't viewed as a long-term concern. The big man can be considered questionable for Tuesday's exhibition against the Warriors until the Lakers provide an update on his status.
4433136.name: Walker Kessler
4433136.short_comment: Kessler (finger) was a full participant in Sunday's practice, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

4433137.long_comment: Williams has missed two straight preseason games due to the injury, which was previously labeled as general soreness. It's unclear when he'll be cleared to play, but it doesn't sound like he's practicing at full capacity yet.
4433137.name: Ziaire Williams
4433137.short_comment: Lakers head coach JJ Redick said Williams is dealing with a foot contusion, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.

4433174.long_comment: Cardwell is nursing left calf soreness. His status is uncertain for Tuesday's preseason game versus Portland.
4433174.name: Dylan Cardwell
4433174.short_comment: Cardwell (calf) didn't practice Monday, per James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento.

4433188.long_comment: Carter played 25 minutes during Boston's preseason opener against Cleveland on Thursday, but the third-year pro is under the weather and not be available for Saturday's contest. His next chance to play is Wednesday against Charlotte.
4433188.name: Devin Carter
4433188.short_comment: Carter (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's exhibition game against the 76ers, Jack Simone of BostonSportsJournal.com reports.

4433247.long_comment: "[Kuminga] is dealing with a little bit of bumps and bruises that we're just being overly cautious with," said head coach Chris Finch when asked why Kuminga would miss Monday's exhibition. It sounds like there's a decent chance Kuminga will be able to get back out there for Wednesday's preseason meeting with the Pistons.
4433247.name: Jonathan Kuminga
4433247.short_comment: Kuminga (general soreness) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Knicks, Alan Horton of the Timberwolves Radio Network reports.

4433255.long_comment: Holmgren and the rest of the Thunder's regulars won't travel to Atlanta for the first half of a back-to-back set. The talented center has yet to play during the preseason due to a quadriceps contusion, and his status for Tuesday's home game against the Pacers remains unclear.
4433255.name: Chet Holmgren
4433255.short_comment: Holmgren (quadriceps) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Hawks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

4433599.long_comment: It's unclear if Williams will make his preseason debut Tuesday against Golden State, but he's trending in the right direction after missing three straight exhibitions due to a lower-body injury. The two-way wing is expected to spend most of this season in the G League.
4433599.name: Arthur Kaluma
4433599.short_comment: Lakers head coach JJ Redick said Kaluma (lower body) returned to practice Saturday, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.

4433621.long_comment: Duren is still working himself into game shape after sitting out training camp while his contract negotiation played out, but he is hopeful to suit up at some point during the preseason. His next chance to get out there will come Wednesday in Minnesota.
4433621.name: Jalen Duren
4433621.short_comment: Duren (reconditioning) won't suit up for Saturday's preseason game against the Wizards, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

4585618.long_comment: Gilbert continues to deal with patella tendinitis. His last chance to appear this preseason is Friday against the Mavericks.
4585618.name: Keshon Gilbert
4585618.short_comment: Gilbert (knee) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

4592427.long_comment: Jones has yet to make his preseason debut after suffering a hamstring injury early in training camp. The forward has resumed some on-court activity, but Denver appears to be proceeding cautiously with his recovery. His status for the Nuggets' remaining preseason games remains uncertain.
4592427.name: Spencer Jones
4592427.short_comment: Jones (hamstring) did not play in Sunday's 133-128 preseason win over Chicago.

4592699.long_comment: Freeman exited Saturday's exhibition with a shoulder injury and will now miss Monday's preseason game. His next chance to get out there will come Wednesday against the Pistons.
4592699.name: Enrique Freeman
4592699.short_comment: Freeman is out for Monday's preseason matchup with the Knicks due to a right shoulder injury.

4593125.long_comment: Aldama underwent knee surgery in March and has been limited during training camp practices. It's unclear when he'll be cleared to make his Mavericks debut. The 2021 No. 30 overall pick spent his entire career in Memphis before Dallas traded for him in July. In 278 regular-season games (82 starts), Aldama has averaged 10.4 points, 5.4 rebounds and 2.1 assists over 23.4 minutes per contest.
4593125.name: Santi Aldama
4593125.short_comment: Aldama (knee) won't play in Sunday's preseason game against the Rockets, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.

4593803.long_comment: Williams and the rest of the Thunder's regulars won't travel to Atlanta, but they are expected to suit up Tuesday, when they host Indiana. Williams tallied 16 points (8-11 FG, 0-3 3Pt), three rebounds, six assists and two steals across 19 minutes in Wednesday's 128-126 preseason loss to the Bucks.
4593803.name: Jalen Williams
4593803.short_comment: Williams (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Hawks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

4601025.long_comment: Larsson started Saturday's preseason game against the Timberwolves, posting 14 points (4-15 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 6-7 FT), three rebounds and five assists across 24 minutes. However, he left the game due to an illness and didn't return. The ailment isn't expected to impact Larsson's status for Opening Night, but he's missing out on valuable reps with a new-look Heat squad led by Giannis Antetokounmpo.
4601025.name: Pelle Larsson
4601025.short_comment: Larsson (illness) didn't practice Monday, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

4606840.long_comment: Watkins, a two-way player for the Wizards, suffered the injury during the Summer League. Although Washington has yet to offer a timetable for a return, a typical recovery time for the procedure is approximately 9-to-12 months. That leaves Watkins in serious jeopardy of missing most, if not all, of the 2026-27 season, and it remains to be seen if the team will continue keeping him around on a two-way roster spot while he's injured.
4606840.name: Jamir Watkins
4606840.short_comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

4683688.long_comment: Lively underwent right foot surgery in December after appearing in just seven regular-season games in 2025-26, and it's unclear when he'll be ready to play again. Mavericks president Masai Ujiri said Lively has progressed to shooting and is working toward running on the court, while head coach Dusty May said the center is moving well but has a unique return-to-play protocol given all of his missed time in recent years.
4683688.name: Dereck Lively II
4683688.short_comment: Lively (foot) won't play in Sunday's preseason game against the Rockets, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.

4683692.long_comment: Wallace and the rest of the Thunder's regulars won't travel to Atlanta for the first half of a back-to-back set, but they're expected to suit up Tuesday, when they host the Pacers. Wallace is expected to be the starting shooting guard on Opening Night but will face competition from Ajay Mitchell and Jared McCain throughout the season.
4683692.name: Cason Wallace
4683692.short_comment: Wallace (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Hawks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

4683778.long_comment: McCain and the rest of the Thunder's regular won't travel to Atlanta for the first half of a back-to-back set, but they're expected to suit up Tuesday, when they host Indiana. McCain started the preseason opener but is slated for a bench role on Opening Night if everyone is healthy.
4683778.name: Jared McCain
4683778.short_comment: McCain (rest) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hawks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

4684269.long_comment: It doesn't sound like the two-way guard will be available for the preseason, but he's hopeful to not miss any time during the G League season. Boswell is not expected to be a significant part of the Hornets' rotation this season.
4684269.name: Kylan Boswell
4684269.short_comment: Boswell is rehabbing a right knee injury, and he's hopeful to be cleared for basketball activities prior to the start of the G League season in late October.

4684793.long_comment: Filipowski tweaked his back while lifting in the 2025-26 offseason, which caused painful sciatica down his leg throughout the campaign and limited his explosiveness. This offseason, he underwent surgery to fix the herniated disc in his back that was causing the pain, and he's still rehabbing. With Jusuf Nurkic (foot) slated to miss Opening Night, Filipowski's availability moving forward will be one to monitor closely.
4684793.name: Kyle Filipowski
4684793.short_comment: Jazz head coach Will Hardy said Saturday that Filipowski is progressing well and doing the necessary steps to get back on the court, but the big man doesn't have a return timeline, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.

4701230.long_comment: Johnson and most of Atlanta's regulars won't suit up for the penultimate preseason contest. He tallied 20 points (8-12 FG, 2-2 3Pt, 2-3 FT), seven rebounds and three assists over 25 minutes in Saturday's 119-117 preseason win over the Pacers.
4701230.name: Jalen Johnson
4701230.short_comment: Johnson (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

4701232.long_comment: This is a tough blow for the center with training camp right around the corner. With his status for Opening Night in jeopardy, this will put a lot of eyes on Oso Ighodaro and Khaman Maluach, with the latter already drawing buzz during the Summer League. More clarity on Williams' timeline should be known in the coming weeks.
4701232.name: Mark Williams
4701232.short_comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

4702352.long_comment: With Sanders having already missed the Clippers' preseason opener due to a left hip impingement, his continued limitations in practice suggest he still isn't back to full activity. The day-to-day designation keeps him in play to suit up at some point this preseason, but his availability for upcoming exhibition action remains uncertain until he resumes five-on-five work.
4702352.name: Kobe Sanders
4702352.short_comment: Sanders (hip) was limited to individual player development work and did not take part in five-on-five activity Wednesday, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports. Azarly adds that the Clippers said Sanders is day-to-day.

4702656.long_comment: Martin continues to be held out of preseason games while recovering from a knee injury stemming from the NBA Summer League in mid-July. The good news for the second-year pro is that he's been cleared to participate in pracitce, and he could be back on the floor for their next exhibition contest, which takes place Tuesday against the Knicks.
4702656.name: Alijah Martin
4702656.short_comment: Martin (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's preseason game against the Clippers, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

4706557.long_comment: The two-way player is sitting out the first half of this back-to-back set. His next opportunity to play is Tuesday versus the Kings.
4706557.name: Chris Youngblood
4706557.short_comment: Youngblood is out for Monday's preseason game against London with left calf soreness.

4712849.long_comment: Black was a full participant in Friday's practice, but he is still not ready to make his preseason debut due to a right ankle sprain. His next opportunity to suit up comes Wednesday against the Cavaliers.
4712849.name: Anthony Black
4712849.short_comment: Black (ankle) is out for Sunday's preseason game against the Cavaliers, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

4712863.long_comment: Gueye will be re-evaluated by medical staff in 3-to-4 months, which means he'll miss all of training camp and preseason and likely the start of the 2026-27 regular season. It's a brutal blow for the fourth-year big man, given that the Hawks used the No. 23 overall pick of the 2026 NBA Draft to select St. John's product Zuby Ejiofor. Gueye's absence means Ejiofor will have more opportunities in the preseason, and the rookie could establish a key role off the bench behind Onyeka Okongwu and projected backup center Jock Landale (ankle).
4712863.name: Mouhamed Gueye
4712863.short_comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

4845367.long_comment: The Spurs planned to rest several regulars for Monday's contest before the preseason began, so Castle's absence is not believed to be injury-related. Victor Wembanyama, De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper and Devin Vassell are also among the players sitting out. Castle's next opportunity to suit up will come Wednesday against the Suns.
4845367.name: Stephon Castle
4845367.short_comment: Castle (rest) will not play in Monday's preseason matchup against Utah, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.

4869342.long_comment: Daniels and most of Atlanta's regulars will rest during the Hawks' penultimate preseason contest. He tallied 13 points (6-16 FG, 1-3 3Pt), 11 rebounds, an assist and a steal across 21 minutes in Thursday's 123-116 preseason win over the Spurs but struggled with his shot against the Pacers on Saturday.
4869342.name: Dyson Daniels
4869342.short_comment: Daniels (rest) has been ruled out for Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

4870562.long_comment: Barlow also missed Monday's preseason opener against New York due to the back issue. His next opportunity to make his preseason debut will come Oct. 16 against Boston.
4870562.name: Dominick Barlow
4870562.short_comment: Barlow (back) isn't expected to play in either of Philadelphia's next two preseason games against Brooklyn and Boston, Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com reports.

4870564.long_comment: Jefferson will be sidelined for his third straight exhibition. The rookie forward will have one more chance to return in the preseason Oct. 14 against the Heat.
4870564.name: Joshua Jefferson
4870564.short_comment: Jefferson (back) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Wizards, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

4871141.long_comment: Hukporti went down with an Achilles injury in Monday's preseason opener against the Knicks, and an MRI has since revealed a rupture. He signed a one-year deal with the 76ers over the summer, so Hukporti will be an unrestricted free agent come season's end. With Hukporti's year already finished, Adem Bona (foot) should assume the backup center role behind Joel Embiid once healthy.
4871141.name: Ariel Hukporti
4871141.short_comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

4871144.long_comment: Sengun recorded 16 points (6-9 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 4-5 FT), 10 rebounds, 10 assists, one steal and three blocks in 22 minutes during Friday's 135-117 preseason win over Dallas but will take a seat Sunday. Sengun is coming off another impressive year, averaging 20.4 points, 8.9 rebounds, 6.2 assists, 1.2 steals and 1.1 blocks in 33.3 minutes per game across 72 regular-season appearances in 2025-26. However, the star center shot just 69.1 percent from the charity stripe and 30.5 percent from downtown. He's been focused on improving in those areas this offseason, and an uptick in efficiency would be a s
4871144.name: Alperen Sengun
4871144.short_comment: Sengun (rest) isn't expected to play in Sunday's preseason game against the Mavericks, Will Guillory of The Athletic reports.

4873153.long_comment: Johnson started at center during his Mavericks preseason debut, totaling four points (1-3 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 1-2 FT), two rebounds, one assist and one steal in 12 minutes during Friday's 135-117 loss to the Rockets. The rookie has been dealing with a minor lower-leg injury during training camp, so the Mavericks will likely proceed with caution, but it appears he's slated for a major role right away.
4873153.name: Morez Johnson Jr.
4873153.short_comment: Johnson (rest) won't play in Sunday's preseason game against the Rockets, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.

4897943.long_comment: Knecht is dealing with an undisclosed contusion. His next opportunity to take the floor will come in Tuesday's preseason meeting with the Warriors.
4897943.name: Dalton Knecht
4897943.short_comment: Knecht won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Kings due to a contusion, Mike Trudell of Spectrum SportsNet reports.

4898010.long_comment: Sellers continues to deal with lower-back soreness that has limited his preseason availability. The two-way guard will look to return to action as Chicago completes its exhibition schedule, though his immediate fantasy outlook remains limited.
4898010.name: Jaylin Sellers
4898010.short_comment: Sellers (back) did not play in Sunday's 133-128 preseason loss to Denver.

4898371.long_comment: Raynaud was taken back to the locker room in a wheelchair during Saturday's preseason loss to the Warriors, though he's seemingly avoided a serious injury. The big man will still begin the regular season on the inactive list, leaving additional minutes available for the likes of Precious Achiuwa and Dylan Cardwell (rest).
4898371.name: Maxime Raynaud
4898371.short_comment: Raynaud has been diagnosed with a right knee subluxation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

4900671.long_comment: Mitchell and the rest of the Thunder's regular won't travel to Atlanta for the first half of a back-to-back set, but they're expected to suit up Tuesday, when they host the Pacers. After a breakout 2025-26 campaign, Mitchell is one of the preseason favorites for Sixth Man of the Year.
4900671.name: Ajay Mitchell
4900671.short_comment: Mitchell (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Hawks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

4914336.long_comment: It's a tough blow to the Trail Blazers' depth on the wing ahead of training camp. Sharpe, who is now likely to be sidelined until after the All-Star break, had been ticketed for a reserve role behind Toumani Camara following an injury-plagued 2025-26 campaign, which saw average a career-high 20.8 points, 1.4 steals and 2.1 three-pointers per game over 50 regular-season appearances. The door is now open for Vit Krejci and Jeremy Sochan to compete for bench minutes during camp.
4914336.name: Shaedon Sharpe
4914336.short_comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

4997530.long_comment: Diop missed Thursday's preseason-opening loss to the Celtics for undisclosed reasons but is now listed as out due to a left knee injury. His next chance to play in the preseason will come in Tuesday's rematch against Orlando.
4997530.name: Khalifa Diop
4997530.short_comment: Diop (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's preseason game against the Magic, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.

4997537.long_comment: Although the big man will remain a limited participant in training camp as he continues his rehab from a hip impingement, it sounds like his absence from game action will extend into the regular season. Deandre Ayton should have the backup center role all to himself until Vukcevic is cleared to retake the floor.
4997537.name: Tristan Vukcevic
4997537.short_comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

5037871.long_comment: Harper is joining the rest of the Spurs' regular starters on the sidelines Monday. His next chance to play comes Wednesday against the Suns.
5037871.name: Dylan Harper
5037871.short_comment: Harper (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against Utah, per Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News.

5060701.long_comment: Anderson will miss a second straight game due to a left ankle sprain. His next chance to suit up will come in Wednesday's exhibition against the Celtics.
5060701.name: Christian Anderson
5060701.short_comment: Anderson (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's preseason game against Milwaukee.

5061568.long_comment: Bryant exited Saturday's preseason loss to Phoenix after rolling his right ankle in the first half and did not return, so the Spurs are giving him a day to recover Monday. His next chance to play comes Wednesday against the Suns.
5061568.name: Carter Bryant
5061568.short_comment: Bryant (ankle) won't play in Monday's preseason game against Utah, per Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News.

5061575.long_comment: Knueppel's status for Opening Night remains uncertain as he continues to work his way back from his left hamstring injury. Peterson's comments suggest the Hornets aren't ready to rule out the second-year wing, though his availability will likely become clearer as training camp progresses. He has already been ruled out for the entire preseason, to be clear.
5061575.name: Kon Knueppel
5061575.short_comment: Hornets general manager Jeff Peterson said Monday that he "doesn't know" whether Knueppel (hamstring) will be available for the team's regular-season opener against the Nets, Owen Watterson of SI.com reports.

5061603.long_comment: Sorber and the rest of the Thunder's regulars won't travel to Atlanta for the first half of a back-to-back set. The second-year forward missed all of 2025-26 while recovering from an ACL tear, underwent a minor arthroscopic procedure in the same knee this offseason and has yet to suit up during the preseason.
5061603.name: Thomas Sorber
5061603.short_comment: Sorber (knee) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Hawks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

5082206.long_comment: Burries played well in Milwaukee's preseason game Wednesday, logging 16 points, five rebounds, two steals and an assist in 21 minutes, but he will sit out of Sunday's matchup with the Hornets. His next opportunity to play comes Wednesday against the Bulls.
5082206.name: Brayden Burries
5082206.short_comment: Burries will not play in Sunday's preseason game against the Hornets due to a coach's decision, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.

5101761.long_comment: Brown has yet to suit up during the preseason as he continues to work his way back from a left ankle issue. His final chance to get in an exhibition is Wednesday against the Heat.
5101761.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
5101761.short_comment: Brown (ankle) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Wizards, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

5101845.long_comment: The Spurs are expected to exercise extreme caution with the big man, as Quaintance suffered a torn ACL and meniscus with Arizona State in February 2025 before appearing in only four games with Kentucky last season due to severe complications and persistent swelling. The 19-year-old underwent a cleanup procedure on his meniscus in mid-July, and the Spurs will likely want him at 100 percent before ramping him up to basketball activities.
5101845.name: Jayden Quaintance
5101845.short_comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

5104157.long_comment: The Spurs planned to rest several regulars against Utah before the preseason began, so Wembanyama's absence appears to be a routine precaution rather than an injury-related concern. San Antonio will also sit Stephon Castle, De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper and Devin Vassell, among others. Wembanyama's next opportunity to play will come Wednesday against the Suns.
5104157.name: Victor Wembanyama
5104157.short_comment: Wembanyama (rest) will not play in Monday's preseason matchup against the Jazz, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.

5105571.long_comment: Veesaar suffered the injury during a workout on Sept. 15, and an MRI confirmed the diagnosis. The No. 52 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Veesaar was expected to spend a lot of time with Atlanta's G League affiliate this season.
5105571.name: Henri Veesaar
5105571.short_comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

5105637.long_comment: Bona is already expected to miss Friday's preseason finale against Boston, but he's still aiming to be ready for the start of the regular season. Once healthy, Bona is in line to serve as the No. 2 center behind Joel Embiid.
5105637.name: Adem Bona
5105637.short_comment: Bona (foot) practiced in a limited fashion Monday, per Ky Carlin of USA Today.

5106268.long_comment: Tomlin will miss a second straight contest to open the preseason due to lower back soreness. His next chance to suit up comes Wednesday against the Magic.
5106268.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
5106268.short_comment: Tomlin (back) is out for Sunday's preseason game against the Magic, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.

5107251.long_comment: With Nelson still in recovery mode from the left ankle surgery he underwent this summer, his path back to game action remains delayed for the early part of the season. The rookie big man is on a two-way contract with the Magic, so his short-term absence mainly affects his developmental timeline rather than Orlando's regular rotation.
5107251.name: Izaiyah Nelson
5107251.short_comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

5108024.long_comment: Niederhauser is progressing from March surgery but won't be able to suit up to begin the year. The Clippers are likely to take a cautious approach with the 2025 first-rounder. Isaiah Jackson should occupy the backup center spot behind Brook Lopez early in the campaign.
5108024.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
5108024.short_comment: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

5113969.long_comment: Carr and several other players are reportedly dealing with minor injuries, per Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com, but the Lakers aren't concerned about him missing any regular-season action. His next chance to play will arrive Tuesday against the Warriors.
5113969.name: Cameron Carr
5113969.short_comment: Carr (undisclosed) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Kings, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.

5149115.long_comment: Graves is progressing from a groin injury. His status remains unknown for Tuesday's preseason game against the Knicks.
5149115.name: Allen Graves
5149115.short_comment: Graves (groin) practiced Monday, per Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet.

5157066.long_comment: Furphy started in 21 of 35 regular-season appearances for the Pacers, posting averages of 5.1 points, 4.4 rebounds, 1.2 assists and 0.7 three-pointers in 18.4 minutes per contest. While no timetable has been announced, Furphy's absence could extend through the beginning of the 2026-27 season. With this news, the Pacers will likely lean more on Ben Sheppard, Kam Jones and Quenton Jackson moving forward.
5157066.name: Johnny Furphy
5157066.short_comment: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

5157587.long_comment: Zikarsky will be inactive for Monday's road tilt, presumably for rest purposes. The young center's next chance to suit up will come Wednesday against the Pistons.
5157587.name: Rocco Zikarsky
5157587.short_comment: Zikarsky (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Monday's preseason game against the Knicks.

5159925.long_comment: Topic and the rest of the Thunder's regular won't travel to Atlanta for the first half of a back-to-back set. The 2024 lottery pick has yet to play this preseason after undergoing back surgery in mid-June, and it's unclear when he'll be cleared for game action.
5159925.name: Nikola Topic
5159925.short_comment: Topic (back) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Hawks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

5164559.long_comment: Ament will miss Sunday's preseason game due to a left ankle injury he sustained in Wednesday's game against the Thunder. His next chance to suit up comes Wednesday against the Bulls.
5164559.name: Nate Ament
5164559.short_comment: Ament (ankle) is out for Sunday's preseason game against the Hornets, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Networkreports.

5214640.long_comment: Jakucionis was a DNP-CD in Monday's 116-97 preseason loss to Minnesota. He logged 18 minutes in the two-point win over OKC on Wednesday. However, Jakucionis will take a seat once again Sunday, with his next opportunity to play coming Wednesday versus Chicago.
5214640.name: Kasparas Jakucionis
5214640.short_comment: Jakucionis (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's preseason game against Charlotte, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.

6430.long_comment: Butler is still months away from retaking the floor, according to Nick Friedell of The Athletic, so a season debut at some point December might be too optimistic. The star forward remains without a definitive timeline for a return after undergoing ACL surgery in early February, which typically carries at least a nine-month recovery period. Butler makes sense as an injury stash at the end of fantasy drafts, but managers should likely be bracing for him to miss at least the first two months of the regular season.
6430.name: Jimmy Butler III
6430.short_comment: The Warriors hope to have Butler (knee) back early in 2027, per Keith Watkins of Yahoo Sports.

6440.long_comment: "It's a calf strain, the seriousness is what it is," said Johnson. "We won't rush him at all. I guess the question will be is he ready for the season opener? Totally questionable and we will not push that at all. So, we'll take it slow. There is no concern of this level of seriousness, and at the same time, we will not rush him at all." It sounds like Harris, who has already been ruled out for the preseason, is in danger of missing opening night. His absence will open up minutes for Julian Champagnie, Keldon Johnson and Harrison Barnes.
6440.name: Tobias Harris
6440.short_comment: Spurs head coach Mitch Johnson said they will not rush Tobias Harris (calf) back to the court, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.

6475.long_comment: The 36-year-old vet will receive a maintenance day Saturday, but he should be back in action for Wednesday's preseason meeting with the Nets. Tim Hardaway should be more involved in the rotation Saturday with Thompson unavailable.
6475.name: Klay Thompson
6475.short_comment: Thompson (rest) is out for Saturday's preseason game against the Timberwolves, Eric Nehm of The Athletic reports.

6580.long_comment: With Beal already set to miss the start of training camp, it sounds like the veteran guard still hasn't progressed to full-contact work. His continued knee inflammation keeps his ramp-up timeline uncertain and suggests the Clippers will continue to manage his workload in camp.
6580.name: Bradley Beal
6580.short_comment: Beal (knee) isn't participating in five-on-five work and is doing individual player development work, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports. Azarly adds that the Clippers said Wednesday that Beal is continuing to have inflammation managed.

6583.long_comment: Davis is getting the night off Monday for maintenance purposes. The star big man's next chance to play is Friday against the Pelicans.
6583.name: Anthony Davis
6583.short_comment: Davis (rest) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Nets, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

6606.long_comment: Portland is giving the veteran guard a maintenance day Monday. His next chance to play is Tuesday against the Kings.
6606.name: Damian Lillard
6606.short_comment: Lillard (rest) is out for Monday's preseason game against London.

6609.long_comment: Middleton has yet to play in the preseason as he ramps up his conditioning. The veteran forward's next chance to suit up will come Friday against New Orleans.
6609.name: Khris Middleton
6609.short_comment: Middleton (rest) was unavailable for Monday's 131-122 preseason loss to Brooklyn, Greg Finberg of Wizardscentral.com reports.
